question: Which measured B-Rep facts establish a bounded, coaxial nested-cylinder and planar-shoulder relation without assigning a feature label?
model_class: two nested +Z cylindrical faces with one planar annular shoulder in the frozen prismatic family

required_facts: shared axis direction and axis location within a frozen tolerance
one planar face adjacent to both cylinders
ambiguity_or_fail_closed_conditions: more or fewer than two cylinders
feature label or reference-script variant used as an input fact

constrained_hypothesis: A nested-cylinder relation may be reported only when measured coaxiality, radius ordering and a shared planar shoulder all hold; otherwise it is unsupported.

stopping_rule: do not call the relation a counterbore or infer original history
do not widen M30's single-cylinder rule
do not change public probe, runtime, helper, IR, SDK, manifest or provider behavior

existing: M30's three counterbore records are multi-cylinder negative controls for the single-cylinder blind/through unit; they have not been used as positive nested-cylinder evidence.
missing_counterexample: a two-cylinder input with no shared planar shoulder or non-coaxial axes that must remain unsupported
evidence.next_minimal_experiment: Completed by M32-002: the offline reporter measured the relation in three frozen rows and rejected temporary non-coaxial and missing-shoulder controls. Any extension must isolate a new relation or axis condition without assigning a feature label.
